label: Memory
description: Saves personal details shared in conversation as persistent facts.

label: Date Awareness
description: Lets the model look up the current date and time on demand.

label: Calculator
description: Evaluates math expressions precisely using the JS engine — no hallucination.

label: Reminders
description: Sets timed browser notifications.

label: To-Do List
description: Manages a persistent to-do list stored in your browser.

label: Unit Converter
description: Converts between length, mass, temperature, volume, speed, area, and data units.

label: Wikipedia
description: Fetches a real Wikipedia summary instead of hallucinating facts.

label: Location
description: Gets your approximate location for context-aware answers.

label: Dice Roller
description: Rolls dice (d4–d100, NdX+M notation) or flips a coin using crypto-random values.

label: Text-to-Speech
description: Narrates model responses aloud using the Web Speech API.

label: Password Generator
description: Generates cryptographically random passwords with configurable length and character sets.

label: Encode/Decode
description: Encodes and decodes text: Base64, URL encoding, HTML entities.

label: Color Converter
description: Converts colors between hex, RGB, and HSL formats.

label: Timezone Converter
description: Shows the current time in any IANA timezone, or converts a specific time between zones.

label: Hash
description: Computes SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, or SHA-512 digests via the Web Crypto API.

label: ROT13
description: Applies ROT13 substitution cipher (self-inverse: same operation encodes and decodes).

label: Caesar Cipher
description: Encodes or decodes text with a configurable alphabetic shift.

label: Morse Code
description: Encodes text to Morse code or decodes Morse back to text.

label: Tone Generator
description: Plays a continuous sine-wave tone at a given frequency or note name via Web Audio API.

label: Metronome
description: Plays a click track at a given BPM using Web Audio API scheduling.

label: Morse Audio
description: Plays text as Morse code beeps via Web Audio API.

label: DTMF Tones
description: Plays telephone keypad dual-tone multi-frequency (DTMF) tones via Web Audio.

label: NATO Phonetic
description: Spells text using the NATO phonetic alphabet (Alpha, Bravo, Charlie…).

label: Number to Words
description: Converts integers to English words (e.g. 1234 → "one thousand two hundred thirty-four").

label: Roman Numerals
description: Converts integers (1–3999) to Roman numerals and back.

label: Radix Converter
description: Converts numbers between binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal bases.

label: Flip Text
description: Renders text upside-down using Unicode look-alike characters.

label: Pig Latin
description: Translates English text to Pig Latin.

label: Leet Speak
description: Translates text to 1337 5p34k substitution cipher.

label: Pirate Speak
description: Translates text into pirate dialect (ahoy, matey, arrr).

label: Scrabble Score
description: Calculates the Scrabble tile point value for any word.

label: Haiku Checker
description: Checks whether a three-line poem follows the 5-7-5 syllable structure.

label: Readability Score
description: Computes the Flesch Reading Ease score and estimated grade level for any text.

label: Statistics
description: Computes mean, median, mode, std dev, min, max, and more for a list of numbers.

label: Compound Interest
description: Calculates compound interest: final amount, interest earned, and return percentage.

label: Sleep Cycles
description: Suggests optimal bedtimes or wake times based on 90-minute REM cycle math.

label: Sequences
description: Generates terms of Fibonacci, primes, triangular, square, cube, factorial, or powers-of-2 sequences.
